issues.title: Remove the sync_publishing feature flag and dead code behind it

issues.title: Coil ImageLoader singleton
issues.body:
According to [Coil's documentation](https://coil-kt.github.io/coil/image_loaders/#singleton-vs-dependency-injection):

> Coil performs best when you have a single ImageLoader that's shared throughout your app. This is because each ImageLoader has its own set of resources.

We should update the app to follow that advice.

issues.title: Improve wording of no connection message
issues.body: We use the strings "No network available" (title) and "There is no network available" (message) together in several places when we detect there's no network connection. We should use better wording, or simply use only the title string and no message.

issues.title: [Reader] Use "follow" for tags
issues.body:
We recently changed several Strings in the apps from "follow"/"followed"/"following" to "subscribe"/"subscribed"/"subscriptions", but it turns out these new terms should be only used for **blogs**, so we now need to revert some of those changes back to the "follow" when talking about **tags**.

Internal ref: p1709029253585639/1708546908.187529-slack-C05N140C8H5

issues.title: The app does not preserve location metadata in uploaded pictures
issues.body:
The app does not preserve location metadata in pictures uploaded from mobile devices, even when the `Remove Location from media` setting is turned off in the Settings screen. 
Additionally, toggling off the `Optimize images` feature does not affect this outcome. In theory, when this setting is off the picture should be uploaded as-is, without any modifications.  

When uploading the same picture via the web, location metadata are retained, indicating the issue is specific to the mobile app.

issues.title: TRAFFIC tab crashed when Talkback is enabled.
issues.body:
### Expected behavior
The traffic tab should work with accessibility.

### Actual behavior
When Talkback is enabled, the app crashes on opening the Traffic Tab.

### Steps to reproduce the behavior
1. Log in JP app.
2. Enable "stats_traffic_tab" from "Me → Debug settings"
3. Enable Talkback from the device settings.
4. Open "My Site → Stats"
5. Open the TRAFFIC tab and select By week, By month or By year.
6. Notice it crashes.

issues.body:
This issue and it's cause were discovered by @daniloercoli.

When the user has many blogs (probably > 100, see below) some of them won't be shown in the `Subscriptions` feed or `Manage Tags & Blogs` screen. This happens because paging is not handled (like it is on web client) in [our implementation of the `read/following/mine` endpoint](https://github.com/wordpress-mobile/WordPress-Android/blob/trunk/WordPress/src/main/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/reader/services/update/ReaderUpdateLogic.java

issues.title: [Reader Improvements] Fix follow tag responsiveness on "Manage Topics & Sites" screen
issues.body:
When user taps to add a new tag on "Manage Topics & Sites" ("Followed Topics" tab) it takes a while to update the tags list. This happens because we wait for the network response and also the local DB update before updating the UI.

We should update the UI immediately after the the user taps on the add button and if the network request fails we show the previous status.

issues.title: [Reader Improvements] Fix like/dislike button responsiveness on Discover
issues.body:
When user taps on the like/dislike post button on `Discover` tab it takes a while to update the button status. This happens because we wait for the network response and also the local DB update before updating the UI. The same doesn't happen on `Following` and `Liked` tabs.

We should update the UI immediately after the user taps on the like button and if the network request fails we show the previous status.

issues.title: [Reader Performance] Remove unnecessary query parameter from read/following API requests
issues.body: When Reader's "Following" tab is opened we're currently sending a request to `read/following` endpoint with the `meta=site,likes` query parameter. The extra data that comes with this query parameter doesn't seem to be used in the context of the "Following" tab, and the response is significantly smaller without it so we should remove it.

When downloading a file on the reader, if the "Don't ask again" option is selected for file download before, the app should inform the user and forward them to the system settings.
